_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series Z1XYW/6 SET-1, Q.P. Code 31/6/1. 32 page images (cover announces 31 printed pages; idx 31, folio 32, is BLANK apart from the QR code and the 112 A box, confirmed at full size). idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-30, Hindi on every odd index 3-29 (each the Hindi of the page after it). Odd-page tops checked: idx 5, 17, 19, 23, 25, 27, 29 at full size and the rest on the contact sheet, all Hindi (idx 17 opens with the Hindi of Q25(b), whose English sits at the top of idx 18). English numbering runs 1-39 unbroken across idx 4-30. Printed instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 MCQ x1 (Q17-20 Assertion-Reason), B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4 (case/data based). Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 2-10) for a bare OR: Q22, 25, 28, 29, 34, 36, 37(c), 38(c), 39(c) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Q33 prints (a) and (b) with NO OR and one marks figure, and the scheme awards both, so it is one row; likewise Q35 (a)-(e). Q25's OR sits between two unlabelled two-part blocks ((a)+(b) OR (a)+(b)), so questionNumber is '25' / '25 OR'. Section E prints its alternatives as '(c) ... OR (c) ...', so questionNumber is '37 (c)' / '37 (c) OR' and refs Q37ci/Q37cii (the 2024 31/2/1 convention); sub-part marks (a)1 (b)1 (c)2 come from the scheme, the paper prints only 4 per question. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each re-derived: all 20 agree, Q16 flagged as arguable. No void, grace note or dual key anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points on this paper are ORDINARY full stops (Q25: 2.42 and 1.33) although its marking scheme prints raised dots (1·33); the paper wins. Table-row MCQs (Q2, Q3, Q4, Q6) carry each row as 'Column: value; Column: value'. Typesetting slips: Q5 option (b) prints a double comma 'chloroplast,,' (kept as printed); Q20 Reason prints 'compoünds' with a stray diaeresis (a glyph artefact, written 'compounds'). Opener of series 31/6: nothing skipped (plan.txt lists no reference).
